people.selection_sql:
SELECT id, relevance, tie FROM (
    SELECT x.id AS id, (GREATEST(
    CASE WHEN popularia_search_text(x.handle) = popularia_search_text(?) THEN 400 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN popularia_search_text(x.handle) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!' THEN 300 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN popularia_search_text(x.display_name) = popularia_search_text(?) THEN 220 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN popularia_search_text(x.display_name) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!' THEN 160 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN popularia_search_text(x.display_name || ' ' || x.handle) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!' THEN 100 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN ? = 1 AND similarity(popularia_search_text(x.handle), popularia_search_text(?)) >= 0.4 THEN 50 ELSE 0 END,
    CASE WHEN ? = 1 AND similarity(popularia_search_text(x.display_name), popularia_search_text(?)) >= 0.4 THEN 40 ELSE 0 END
)) AS relevance, ((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM x.created_at) * 1000)::bigint) AS tie
    FROM app_user x
    WHERE x.status = 'active' AND x.id <> ? AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_id = ? AND b.blocked_id = x.id) OR (b.blocked_id = ? AND b.blocker_id = x.id)) AND (
    popularia_search_text(x.display_name || ' ' || x.handle) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!'
    OR (? = 1 AND (
        popularia_search_text(x.handle) % popularia_search_text(?)
        OR popularia_search_text(x.display_name) % popularia_search_text(?)
    ))
)
) scored
WHERE relevance > 0
  AND (
    ? = 0
    OR relevance < ?
    OR (relevance = ? AND tie < ?)
    OR (relevance = ? AND tie = ? AND id < CAST(? AS uuid))
  )
ORDER BY relevance DESC, tie DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 21

Sort Key: (GREATEST(CASE WHEN (popularia_search_text((x.handle)::text) = 'educacao'::text) THEN 400 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (popularia_search_text((x.handle)::text) ~~ 'educacao%'::text) THEN 300 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (popularia_search_text((x.display_name)::text) = 'educacao'::text) THEN 220 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (popularia_search_text((x.display_name)::text) ~~ 'educacao%'::text) THEN 160 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (popularia_search_text((((x.display_name)::text || ' '::text) || (x.handle)::text)) ~~ '%educacao%'::text) THEN 100 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (similarity(popularia_search_text((x.handle)::text), 'educacao'::text) >= '0.4'::double precision) THEN 50 ELSE 0 END, CASE WHEN (similarity(popularia_search_text((x.display_name)::text), 'educacao'::text) >= '0.4'::double precision) THEN 40 ELSE 0 END)) DESC

posts.selection_sql:
SELECT id, relevance, tie FROM (
    SELECT x.id AS id, ((
    CASE
        WHEN popularia_search_text(x.body) = popularia_search_text(?) THEN 1000
        WHEN popularia_search_text(x.body) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!' THEN 800
        WHEN popularia_search_text(x.body) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!' THEN 400
        WHEN to_tsvector('portuguese', popularia_search_text(x.body)) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('portuguese', popularia_search_text(?)) THEN 300
        WHEN ? = 1 AND word_similarity(popularia_search_text(?), popularia_search_text(x.body)) >= 0.45 THEN 200
        ELSE 0
    END
    + CASE
        WHEN popularia_search_text(x.body) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!'
            OR to_tsvector('portuguese', popularia_search_text(x.body)) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('portuguese', popularia_search_text(?))
        THEN LEAST(99, FLOOR(ts_rank(to_tsvector('portuguese', popularia_search_text(x.body)), websearch_to_tsquery('portuguese', popularia_search_text(?))) * 100)::int)
        ELSE 0
    END
)) AS relevance, ((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM x.created_at) * 1000)::bigint) AS tie
    FROM post x JOIN app_user a ON a.id = x.author_id LEFT JOIN comuna c ON c.id = x.comuna_id
    WHERE x.status = 'published' AND a.status = 'active' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_block b WHERE (b.blocker_id = ? AND b.blocked_id = a.id) OR (b.blocked_id = ? AND b.blocker_id = a.id)) AND (c.id IS NOT NULL OR NOT a.is_private OR a.id = ? OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_follow pf WHERE pf.follower_id = ? AND pf.followed_id = a.id AND pf.approved)) AND (c.id IS NULL OR (c.status = 'active' AND (c.visibility = 'public' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM comuna_membership m WHERE m.comuna_id = c.id AND m.user_id = ?)))) AND (
    popularia_search_text(x.body) LIKE popularia_search_text(?) ESCAPE '!'
    OR to_tsvector('portuguese', popularia_search_text(x.body)) @@ websearch_to_tsquery('portuguese', popularia_search_text(?))
    OR (? = 1 AND word_similarity(popularia_search_text(?), popularia_search_text(x.body)) >= 0.45)
)
) scored
WHERE relevance > 0
  AND (
    ? = 0
    OR relevance < ?
    OR (relevance = ? AND tie < ?)
    OR (relevance = ? AND tie = ? AND id < CAST(? AS uuid))
  )
ORDER BY relevance DESC, tie DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 21
